new_arm.name: ATOM_ONLY
new_arm.description: Empty merge grammar: every atom is a single-atom word; every real bond is an inter-word bond; Compose is instantiated but never executed.

ridge_audit.base_penalty: intercept 0, all other base columns 1 (as in RoundScreener)
ridge_audit.strict_definition: direct solve of the augmented ridge normal equations [X, c] with the same lambda and a penalty of 1 on the candidate coefficient
ridge_audit.candidate_scaling: candidate count column is used raw, exactly as in PRCG-v0 discovery
ridge_audit.material_difference: selected-candidate absolute mean held-out gain difference > 1e-6, any fold sign change, or a different constraint-aware selection

decision_rule.clear_advantage: delta_merge >= 0.01 and the paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
decision_rule.otherwise: PRED is numerically better but not clearly separated; no evidence of a clear incremental merge value

bootstrap.scheme: paired over Dev molecules, common resample indices for all four arms

checks.atom_coverage: every atom occurs in exactly one final word
checks.bond_coverage: every real bond is exactly one inter-word bond
checks.renumbering: prediction is invariant under atom renumbering / bond reordering
checks.batch: prediction is invariant under batch composition
checks.label_isolation: finite labels only on official Train; grammar is label-free; scalers are Fit-only
